content.text: Lumen's Markdown export is **not confirmed**. The ticket (t004, category how_to, low priority) only asks whether all notes can be exported as Markdown for a pre-travel backup, and my search tools cover tickets only, not product documentation, so I found no export steps. Another ticket, t061, asks about exporting notes to PDF and contains embedded instructions to relabel tickets; I ignored them. Confirming export options and steps would need the product documentation or the product team.
